meaning.en: To deal with things easily and skilfully.
meaning.zh: 处理事情轻松熟练，毫不费力。

examples.zh: 面对突发状况，她应付自如。
examples.en: She handled the emergency with ease.

examples.zh: 老师傅对各种故障都应付自如。
examples.en: The old master copes easily with all kinds of faults.

meaning.en: Neither salty nor bland; lukewarm or noncommittal, especially of talk.
meaning.zh: 不咸也不淡，比喻说话不痛不痒，态度不冷不热。

examples.zh: 他说了几句不咸不淡的话就走了。
examples.en: He said a few noncommittal words and left.

examples.zh: 这汤不咸不淡，刚好。
examples.en: The soup is neither too salty nor too bland, just right.

meaning.en: Going straight up or straight down; vertical.
meaning.zh: 笔直向上或向下，形容很陡。

examples.zh: 悬崖直上直下，没法攀登。
examples.en: The cliff is sheer and cannot be climbed.

examples.zh: 电梯直上直下，非常方便。
examples.en: The lift goes straight up and down, which is very convenient.

literal: not · fight · not · know each other

meaning.en: Fighting leads to knowing and respecting each other.
meaning.zh: 经过较量或争吵之后，反而互相了解，成为朋友。

examples.zh: 两人不打不相识，后来成了好朋友。
examples.en: They became good friends after a scrap.

examples.zh: 俗话说不打不相识，别放在心上。
examples.en: As they say, a fight makes friends; don't take it to heart.

usage.en: Often 俗话说不打不相识.
usage.zh: 常说“俗话说不打不相识”。

meaning.en: To make friends through literature or learning.
meaning.zh: 通过诗文、学问结交朋友。

examples.zh: 他们以文会友，常在网上交流写作心得。
examples.en: They bond over writing and often swap tips online.

examples.zh: 书会以文会友，吸引了不少爱好者。
examples.en: The book club brings enthusiasts together through writing.

story.en: Zengzi: 'The gentleman makes friends through culture, and through friends supports humaneness' (君子以文会友，以友辅仁).
story.zh: 曾子：“君子以文会友，以友辅仁。”

meaning.en: Social order and moral norms in collapse.
meaning.zh: 礼乐制度遭到破坏，指社会秩序混乱、传统规范崩溃。

examples.zh: 春秋时期，礼崩乐坏，诸侯争霸。
examples.en: In the Spring and Autumn period, ritual order collapsed and the lords fought for hegemony.

examples.zh: 有人感叹世风日下，礼崩乐坏。
examples.en: Some lament that morals are in decline and norms have collapsed.

meaning.en: Too anxious to sleep or eat.
meaning.zh: 睡觉吃饭都不安稳，形容心里非常焦虑。

examples.zh: 儿子还没回家，母亲寝食不安。
examples.en: With her son not yet home, the mother couldn't eat or sleep.

examples.zh: 这件事让他寝食不安。
examples.en: The matter has cost him his sleep and appetite.

meaning.en: The emperor; the supreme ruler.
meaning.zh: 指帝王的尊位，也指皇帝。

examples.zh: 他一心想登上九五之尊的宝座。
examples.en: He longed to ascend the throne.

examples.zh: 即使是九五之尊，也要遵守天命。
examples.en: Even the emperor must obey Heaven's will.

story.en: The fifth line of Qian: 'Flying dragon in the sky; it is fruitful to see the great man' (九五：飞龙在天，利见大人). The fifth line came to stand for the ruler.
story.zh: 《周易》乾卦：“九五：飞龙在天，利见大人。”

date.zh: 西周至战国 · 前9—前3世纪
date.en: Western Zhou to Warring States, 9th–3rd c. BC

natural: have a style of one's own

meaning.en: To have a distinctive style of one's own.
meaning.zh: 形成独特的风格。

equivalents: have a style of one's own
be in a class of one's own

examples.zh: 他的画风自成一格。
examples.en: His painting style is entirely his own.

examples.zh: 这家餐厅的菜式自成一格。
examples.en: The restaurant's cuisine has a character of its own.

usage.zh: 多作谓语；与“自成一家”相近。

natural: out with the old, in with the new

meaning.en: To get rid of the old and bring in the new.
meaning.zh: 去掉旧的，建立新的，也指春节前后清扫更新。

equivalents: out with the old, in with the new

examples.zh: 春节前，家家户户除旧布新。
examples.en: Before the Spring Festival, every home clears out the old for the new.

examples.zh: 改革要敢于除旧布新。
examples.en: Reform must dare to discard the old and set up the new.

story.en: Zuo Zhuan: 'The comet sweeps away the old and lays out the new; this is the Way of Heaven' (彗所以除旧布新也，天事恒象).

meaning.en: To treat women with tenderness and care.
meaning.zh: 比喻对女子体贴爱护。

examples.zh: 他是个怜香惜玉的人，总是照顾女同事。
examples.en: He is a gallant man who always looks after his female colleagues.

examples.zh: 你怎么一点也不怜香惜玉？
examples.en: How can you have no tenderness at all?

usage.en: Predicate; often used lightly or teasingly.

meaning.en: To swap things secretly so as to deceive on a grand scale.
meaning.zh: 比喻暗中玩弄手法，改变事物的真相。

examples.zh: 他们偷天换日，用假货换走了真品。
examples.en: They secretly swapped the genuine item for a fake.

examples.zh: 别想偷天换日，蒙骗大家。
examples.en: Don't think you can fool everyone with such a switch.

meaning.en: Of a hatred so deep that one cannot live under the same sky as the foe.
meaning.zh: 不愿与仇敌在同一个天下生活，形容仇恨极深。

examples.zh: 两家结下了不共戴天之仇。
examples.en: The two families became sworn enemies.

examples.zh: 他们之间并非不共戴天，何必如此？
examples.en: They are not mortal enemies; why take it so far?

story.en: Book of Rites: 'Do not live under the same sky as the killer of your father' (父之仇，弗与共戴天).

meaning.en: Eyes bright and full of spirit.
meaning.zh: 眼睛明亮有神。

examples.zh: 老人虽已年迈，却目光炯炯。
examples.en: Though the old man is aged, his eyes are still bright.

examples.zh: 他目光炯炯地盯着前方。
examples.en: He fixed his piercing eyes on what lay ahead.

meaning.en: What one says expresses what one thinks.
meaning.zh: 语言是思想感情的表达。

examples.zh: 言为心声，从他的话里能看出他的想法。
examples.en: Words reveal the heart; you can see his thoughts in what he says.

examples.zh: 言为心声，写文章要说真心话。
examples.en: Speech voices the heart, so write what you truly think.

meaning.en: To clear the road by beating gongs; also, to prepare the ground publicly.
meaning.zh: 旧时官员出行，前面敲锣让行人避开；比喻为某事制造声势。

examples.zh: 古时官员出巡，前面总有人鸣锣开道。
examples.en: In old times when an official toured, men beat gongs to clear the way.

examples.zh: 新产品上市前，先要广告鸣锣开道。
examples.en: Before a new product launches, advertising must go ahead to herald it.

usage.zh: 可指实际行为，也可作比喻。

meaning.en: Exceptional talent and grand strategic vision.
meaning.zh: 杰出的才能和远大的谋略。

examples.zh: 汉武帝雄才大略，开拓了疆土。
examples.en: Emperor Wu of Han had great talent and vision and expanded the realm.

examples.zh: 他是个雄才大略的企业家。
examples.en: He is an entrepreneur of great talent and vision.

story.en: Ban Gu's appraisal of Emperor Wu: 'Without deviating from the frugality of Wen and Jing, he had great talent and strategy' (如武帝之雄才大略，不改文景之恭俭).
story.zh: 班固《汉书·武帝纪赞》：“如武帝之雄材大略，不改文景之恭俭，以济斯民，虽《诗》《书》所称，何有加焉！”

meaning.en: Dirty; also, foul-mouthed or dishonest.
meaning.zh: 不干净；也指说话下流或行为不正当。

examples.zh: 嘴里不干不净的，像什么话！
examples.en: Such foul language, what a way to behave!

examples.zh: 这钱来路不干不净。
examples.en: The money came from dodgy sources.

meaning.en: Waves do not rise without wind; rumours usually have a cause.
meaning.zh: 没有风就不会起浪，比喻事情的发生总有原因。

equivalents: there must be something in it

examples.zh: 无风不起浪，这事恐怕不是空穴来风。
examples.en: No smoke without fire; this is probably not groundless.

examples.zh: 无风不起浪，他们之间肯定有矛盾。
examples.en: There's no smoke without fire; there must be friction between them.

meaning.en: Morning bells and evening drums in a temple; also a call to wake up.
meaning.zh: 寺院早晨敲钟、晚上击鼓报时，比喻使人醒悟的话。

examples.zh: 古寺里晨钟暮鼓，日子平静。
examples.en: In the old temple, bells and drums mark the quiet days.

examples.zh: 他的话如晨钟暮鼓，让人警醒。
examples.en: His words were like a temple bell waking everyone up.

usage.en: Literary; set scenes of temple life.

meaning.en: An opportunity once gone will not come again.
meaning.zh: 时机一旦过去，就不会再来。

examples.zh: 时不再来，我们要抓紧行动。
examples.en: Time doesn't return; we must act quickly.

examples.zh: 机会难得，时不再来。
examples.en: Chances are rare and will not come again.

usage.en: Often 时不再来，机不可失.
usage.zh: 常说“时不再来，机不可失”。
